objective: Cover a broad valid-input sample with deterministic and seeded-random cases.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact, run every case on Ascend 950PR, and capture odata.
pass_condition: Pass iff every case matches the host floor-mod oracle bitwise across all logical elements.
setup: Generate cases: widths/heights from {1,2,3,16,17,31,2048}; pitch in {width,width+1,width+7}; shifts from {-4096,-1,0,1,width-1,width,width+1,4096}; and 20 seeded-random cases within the admitted domain; compute host floor-mod oracle for each.
